nodes.summary: A class $\mathfrak{X}$ of finite groups is a predicate on finite groups $G$ (with carrier in the lowest type universe, together with their group structure); the groups satisfying it are the members of the class, written $G \in \mathfrak{X}$.
nodes.title: Classes of finite groups (Kourovka 16.82 setting)

nodes.summary: Let $\mathfrak{X}$ be a class of finite groups. For subgroup assignments $\tau_1$ and $\tau_2$, $\tau_1 \le \tau_2$ on $\mathfrak{X}$ when $\tau_1(G) \subseteq \tau_2(G)$ for every $G \in \mathfrak{X}$. This is the order of the lattice $F(\mathfrak{X})$ of closed subgroup functors on $\mathfrak{X}$.
nodes.title: Order on subgroup functors

nodes.summary: A class $\mathfrak{X}$ of finite groups is closed when it contains at least one group and is closed under homomorphic images, subgroups and direct products: if $G \in \mathfrak{X}$ and $f : G \to H$ is a surjective homomorphism onto a finite group $H$, then $H \in \mathfrak{X}$; every subgroup of a group in $\mathfrak{X}$ lies in $\mathfrak{X}$; and if $G, H \in \mathfrak{X}$, then $G \times H \in \mathfrak{X}$.
